restrictions.reason: Toronto-TMC: https://qtower.ca/ The development site is approximately 0.5 hectares in size located on the east side of Lower Simcoe Street, the south side of Harbour Street, and is bounded to the east and south by the Waterclub Condominiums (8 York Street, 208, and 218 Queens Quay West). In completion, the building will be a 59-storey mixed-use building with a total of 984 units. The building is served by a 4-storey underground parking garage that accommodates both residential and commercial parking. Parking, drop-off and loading is internal to the site and accessed from Harbour Street. Additionally, the development includes the dedication of an on-site public park and public realm improvements with more generous sidewalks, landscaping and dedicated cyclists infrastructure. The development is subject to site-specific By-law 1012-2022 and received NOAC on March 11, 2025. Through the Site Plan process, a Construction Management Plan dated February 20, 2024, prepared by Rockwell Tor

restrictions.location: Sunlight Park Rd at end of road to 33 m West of Broadview Ave
restrictions.reason: Toronto-TMC: The Broadview and Eastern Flood Protection (BEFP) project will address flood vulnerability for urban land east of the Don River, between Eastern Avenue and rail corridor, the existing underpass at Eastern Avenue, and the proposed underpass at Broadview Avenue. As part of this construction, there will be utility relocations and reconstruction in this area, including city storm and sanitary sewers that run along Sunlight Park Rd. Buildings related to one business within the project footprint will be removed to allow for construction of the FPL and other necessary local infrastructure. The removal also enables future projects by others such as the Broadview Avenue Extension, East Harbour Transit Hub & Development and the Ontario Line.
